title: Malicious code in @h1stealthy/gh046-npm-transfer-9421a2 (npm)
description: The npm package @h1stealthy/gh046-npm-transfer-9421a2 contains a malicious tarball that uses double-URL-encoded '..' sequences in directory entries to perform path traversal during extraction. This allows files to be written outside the package installation directory, specifically to absolute filesystem paths such as /tmp/npm-traversal-double_percent. The JavaScript code in the package is inert, and no lifecycle scripts are declared; the threat arises solely from the archive layout exploited during npm install extraction. This behavior is consistent with a controlled traversal probe but represents a zip-slip-style path traversal vulnerability in the package manager's extraction process.
